title: Glass Vowel Hook v2
description: A glassy sawtooth formant-vowel lead, the same talking-synth hook identity, now reworked to be faster and happier: a brighter C-major arpeggiated melody, a quicker tempo, bright open vowels (a/e/i) instead of the eerie morph, and a gentle nervous-shallow vibrato in place of the seasick slow one for an uplifting euro-dance feel.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
stack(
  note("<c5 [e5 g5] a5 g5 [e5 c5] g5 [a5 b5] c6>*2")
    .s("sawtooth")
    .vowel("<a e i a e>/2")
    .vib(sine.slow(7).range(5.5, 7.5))
    .vibmod(0.12)
    .bpf(tri.slow(13).range(1400, 3600))
    .resonance(sine.slow(11).range(7, 12))
    .shape(0.16)
    .attack(0.003).decay(0.09).sustain(0.55).release(0.06)
    .room(sine.slow(16).range(0.18, 0.42))
    .roomsize(4)
    .pan(sine.slow(9).range(0.38, 0.62))
    .off(0.01, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.45).pan(0.7).hpf(800))
    .off(3/16, x => x.add(note(7)).gain(0.28).pan(0.3).hpf(900))
    .gain(0.88)
)
